collection.title: Volvo S60 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Volvo S60 from 2019 Onwards is fitted with a new type of wiper blade called the 'AquaBlade'. This unique type of wiper, developed by Valeo, delivers wiper fluid directly onto the windscreen through the wiper blade. The drivers side requires a 24" AquaBlade and a 20" for the passengers side. They are available in both heated and unheated varients but these are not inter-changeable, so replacment must be the same version as originally fitted to your S60.
